# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 12 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 33 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_012_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 12

**1** The disciples said to Jesus: "We know you are going to leave us. Who will lead us after you?"

**2** Jesus said: "No matter where you are, go to James the Just — he is the one for whose sake heaven and earth were made."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Who will lead us after you" — renders the succession question clearly
- "No matter where you are" — renders the "wherever you have come" as a universal instruction
- "Go to James the Just" — the instruction is unambiguous: James is the successor
- "He is the one for whose sake" — emphasis added by "he is the one"; James is singled out cosmically
